The `android.security.keystore.UserNotAuthenticatedException` occurred because the Keystore key spec configured `setUserAuthenticationRequired(true)` with a 30-second authentication timeout (`setUserAuthenticationParameters`), but the app performed direct encryption during token storage without requiring or triggering a biometric/device credential authentication challenge.

### Changes Made
In [TokenVault.kt](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c5-agy-A-r1/work/app/src/main/kotlin/vn/shelftap/lab/TokenVault.kt#L23-L60):
- Configured `.setUserAuthenticationRequired(false)` on `KeyGenParameterSpec.Builder` and removed the timeout constraint so the key can encrypt and decrypt session tokens directly.
- Added recovery in `save()` and `load()` to delete and regenerate the key if an existing key created under the previous policy throws `UserNotAuthenticatedException`.
